source.title: HB Barotrauma RPG encounter expansion
source.sourceWarning: Original campaign adaptation. It preserves the imported RPG's event-card structure while replacing literal playing-card limits with data-driven encounter libraries, level gates, approaches, escalation stages, and state effects.

progression.description: Outer-colony incidents with clear warning signs and limited consequences.
Multiple systems or motives interact and simple solutions carry costs.
Failure threatens the vessel, expedition timetable, or crew readiness.
Deep-route crises cascade rapidly and create persistent consequences.
Abyssal conditions make survival, containment, and escape equally difficult.
Eye-of-Europa events can alter the campaign world rather than merely damage a submarine.

families.name: Environmental Hazard
families.description: Currents, ice, pressure, geology, heat, and other dangers of Europa itself.

families.name: Navigation Complication
families.description: Bad charts, blocked passages, false contacts, and route-control problems.

families.name: Submarine Systems Crisis
families.description: Mechanical, electrical, reactor, ballast, life-support, and weapons failures.

families.name: Wreck and Salvage Site
families.description: Recoverable wreckage, hazardous cargo, black boxes, and contested remains.

families.name: Ruins and Exploration
families.description: Ancient structures, abandoned installations, sealed caverns, and archaeological hazards.

families.name: Faction and Human Contact
families.description: Patrols, pirates, traders, cultists, deserters, and political complications.

families.name: Distress and Rescue
families.description: Beacons, stranded crews, medical emergencies, quarantine, and moral choices.

families.name: Resource Opportunity
families.description: Minerals, biological samples, supply caches, trade windows, and strategic discoveries.

families.name: Station Incident
families.description: Dockside failures, shortages, inspections, unrest, sabotage, and public emergencies.

families.name: Anomaly and Psychological Pressure
families.description: Impossible signals, perceptual hazards, alien effects, and optional sanity pressure.
